rule: Retain all attempts. Two consecutive fresh hosted jobs per OAuth case on the selected candidate. Clarification may answer intent only; no manual documentation repair counts as fresh success.

input.useCase: A web app reads titles and content of Notion pages that each customer explicitly shares with this integration. Read content only. Never create or modify pages; no workspace administration.

Customers authorize a web app to list file and folder names in their Dropbox App Folder only, including continuation until all entries are listed. Read metadata only. Do not download file content or upload, edit, move, or delete any files. Use OAuth for each individual account; no team administration.
Customers connect their individual Todoist accounts to list active task titles, including pagination. Read only. Never create, update, complete or delete tasks. No team administration.
Read issue titles in a project the connected person can access, including pagination. Never create, update or delete issues. Use OAuth for individual customer accounts.

Read titles of work packages the connected person can access, including pagination. Never modify or delete work packages. Use developer-owned OAuth for customer accounts on their own instances; retain the instance base URL as a user input.
Read issue titles in the connected person's workspace, including pagination. Never create, update or delete issues. Use OAuth for each individual customer account.

List repository names visible to the connected person, including pagination. Read only. Never create, edit or delete repositories. Use OAuth for individual customer accounts on their own instances; retain the instance base URL as a user input.
